_comment: Places a foot patrol goes out of its way to have a look at.
An officer whose round starts near one of these will have it built into his
circuit as a corner, and when he arrives he stops, looks about, and talks to
whoever is standing there. Everything after the walk is behaviour the mod
already had -- Rounds gets his notepad out and Chats finds him somebody to
speak to. All this file does is say WHERE, which is the one thing no amount
of code can work out on its own.
Add your own. x, y and z are world coordinates; 'name' only ever appears in
the log, and 'radius' is how close his round has to start before he bothers.
Delete the file and foot patrols simply walk ordinary routes.
